ios.desc:
WordCloudStudio is the ultimate word cloud and word art maker — AI-powered with 10,000+ masks & 1,942 fonts. Create tag clouds, typography posters, GIFs, and video exports.

Why choose WordCloudStudio?

• Color Palette: 8 presets + unlimited custom colors for unique word cloud designs
• Background Image: Custom backgrounds with adjustable opacity, blur & fit modes
• Gallery: Save, browse, reuse & share your word cloud creations anytime
• AI-customised templates: meet your needs with AI Prompt
• Custom templates: Personalise your templates for unique results
• Massive fonts: 1,942 fonts to beautify your word cloud style
• Vast Template Library: 10,000+ templates, still growing with user demand
• Video Recording: Capture the rendering process in stunning HD video
• GIF Animation: Convert word clouds into eye-catching animated GIFs
• Stop Words Processing: Auto-filter common stop words for precise data
• Transparent background: Adjust background color transparency
• Rapid Text Extraction: Extract and visualize data from text sources
• Precise Keyword Adjustment: Fine-tune keywords and word frequencies
• Data import/export: Manage large amounts of data seamlessly
• Image Export & Copy: Export word clouds as images or copy to clipboard
• Cross-Platform: Enjoy flexibility across iOS, macOS, iPad & Vision Pro

Where to use WordCloudStudio?

• Marketing: Eye-catching word clouds for ads, social media, and promotions
• Education: Enhance presentations, study materials, and classroom posters
• Business: Visualize data in reports, proposals, and presentations
• Social Media: Unique, shareable word clouds for profiles and stories
• Data Analysis: Present textual data in visual format for researchers
• Creative Projects: Integrate word clouds into graphic design and artwork
• Events: Beautiful word cloud invitations for parties and gatherings
• Customer Feedback: Display reviews in a visually engaging way
• Book Summaries: Summarize books and movies highlighting key themes
• Team Building: Visually represent group ideas and discussions
• Presentations: Enhance speeches with word clouds emphasizing key points
• Merchandise: Create designs for T-shirts, hoodies, and more
• Gift Customization: Personalize mugs, posters, and cards with word clouds

Download now and subscribe to unlock full access!
